title: Shopify debuts Canvas, a way to build online stores by chatting with AI
slides: What if you could build a store by chatting?
Shopify just launched Canvas, an AI-powered store builder.
It generates entire storefronts from a single conversation.
You can now create a store without writing code.
Try it: describe your dream store in a chat.
thread_text:
1. Chat your store into existence

Shopify's new Canvas tool turns a conversation into a full online store. No code, no templates.

2. AI builds the whole storefront

Canvas generates layout, product pages, and checkout from a single chat. You just describe what you want.

3. No code? No problem.

You can now launch a store without touching a single line of code. Just type a description and hit enter.

4. From idea to live in minutes

What used to take weeks of design and setup now happens in one conversation. Speed changes everything.

5. Your turn: dream it, then chat it

Open Shopify Canvas and type your dream store. See what it builds. Then tell me: would you trust AI with your brand?
